patthana18.22:1.1: sārammaṇaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sārammaṇo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:2.1: sārammaṇaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anārammaṇo na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: anārammaṇaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anārammaṇo na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: sārammaṇaṃ na hetuñca anārammaṇaṃ nahetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca na anārammaṇo na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. cittaduka hetuduke nocittaduka nahetudukaṃ
patthana18.22:3.1: nocittaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nocitto na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:4.1: cittaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no citto na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. cetasikaduka hetuduke nacetasikaduka nahetudukaṃ
patthana18.22:5.1: cetasikaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na cetasiko na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:6.1: cetasikaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na acetasiko na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. cittasampayuttaduka hetuduke nacittasampayuttadu nahetudukaṃ
patthana18.22:7.1: cittasampayuttaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na cittasampayutto na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. saṅkhittaṃ.
patthana18.22:9.1: cittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na cittasaṃsaṭṭho na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana18.22:10.1: hetuyā tīṇi. cittasamuṭṭhānaduka hetuduke nocittasamuṭṭhānaduka nahetudukaṃ
patthana18.22:11.1: cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no cittasamuṭṭhāno na hatu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana18.22:12.1: hetuyā tīṇi. cittasahabhuduka hetuduke nocittasahabhuduka nahetudukaṃ
patthana18.22:13.1: cittasahabhuṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no cittasahabhū na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana18.22:14.1: hetuyā tīṇi. cittānuparivattiduka hetuduke nocittānuparivattiduka nahetudukaṃ
patthana18.22:15.1: cittānuparivattiṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no cittānuparivattī na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana18.22:16.1: hetuyā tīṇi. cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaduka hetuduke nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaduka nahetudukaṃ
patthana18.22:17.1: cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana18.22:18.1: hetuyā tīṇi. cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuduka hetuduke nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuduka nahetudukaṃ
patthana18.22:19.1: cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhū na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana18.22:20.1: hetuyā tīṇi. cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiduka hetuduke nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiduka nahetudukaṃ
patthana18.22:21.1: cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattī na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana18.22:22.1: hetuyā tīṇi. ajjhattikaduka hetuduke naajjhattikaduka nahetudukaṃ
patthana18.22:23.1: bāhiraṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na bāhiro na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:24.1: ajjhattikaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ajjhattiko na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. upādāduka hetuduke naupādāduka nahetudukaṃ
patthana18.22:25.1: noupādā hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na noupādā na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.22:26.1: upādā nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upādā na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. upādinnadukahetuduke naupādin nadukanahetudukaṃ
patthana18.22:27.1: upādinnaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upādinno na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana18.22:28.1: anupādinnaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upādinno na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ. hetuyā cattāri.
patthana18.22:29.1: upādinnaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anupādinno na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana18.22:30.1: anupādinnaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upādinno na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ. hetuyā dve. dvigocchakaduka hetuduke dvigocchakaduka nahetudukaṃ
